model.credit: Supplied Mars 3D model (Blender glTF 2.0 export, embedded textures). Origin and license to be confirmed by the team.

sojourner.alt: The six-wheeled Sojourner rover, with its flat solar-panel top and antenna, on rocky reddish ground at Ares Vallis.
sojourner.caption: Sojourner on the surface of Ares Vallis.
sojourner.credit: Credit not supplied with file; presumed NASA/JPL. Confirm before release.

sojourner.alt: Overhead view of the Pathfinder lander: three opened solar-panel petals resting on deflated airbags on rock-strewn ground.
sojourner.caption: The Pathfinder lander seen from above, petals open on its deflated airbags.
sojourner.credit: Credit not supplied with file; presumed NASA/JPL. Confirm before release.

spirit.alt: Artist's rendering of a Mars Exploration Rover with its camera mast raised and solar wings deployed on a dusty plain.
spirit.caption: Artist's concept of a Mars Exploration Rover. Spirit and Opportunity were identical twins.
spirit.credit: Artist's concept. Credit not supplied with file; presumed NASA/JPL. Confirm before release.

opportunity.alt: Artist's rendering of a Mars Exploration Rover with camera mast, solar wings, and six wheels on rocky orange terrain.
opportunity.caption: Artist's concept of a Mars Exploration Rover. Opportunity and Spirit were identical twins.
opportunity.credit: Artist's concept. Credit not supplied with file; presumed NASA/JPL. Confirm before release.

mer.credit: Supplied Mars Exploration Rover model (Blender glTF 2.0 export). Geometry and texture names match the supplied 24883_MER_static.usdz. Origin and license to be confirmed by the team.
